title: Not resistant to cut marks
text: Not resistant to cut marks. I had these blue melamine plates that I used as prep boards for years.  You could cut on them but it wouldn't cut into them.  These are okay and like plates which I like (no drip off).  But, I have to put a washcloth under to keep them from sliding all over and they got deep gouge marks just from the first use - slicing potatoes for potato salad.  Not impressed with the gouge marks - they will be a pain to scrub out.
